notes: Both directive he's (s004, s017) are unrepresented here: the ASV renders qedmah and tsaphonah as the plain attributives east and north, writing no directional word for the he — contrast the fused southward/northward of JOS.15.2 and 15.8.
s018 carries the clause's copula on the preposition (rule 49), while s005's nominal predicate carries its own copula under rule 20.
